data.summary:
**When:** Any phase.

**Target:** An **ADEPTA SORORITAS CHARACTER** model of yours that was just **destroyed**. The Stratagem can target it even though it was destroyed.

**Effect:** You can pick 1-3 Miracle dice and discard them. As the phase ends, set the model up **unengaged** on the battlefield, as near as possible to the spot where it was destroyed. Its unit's [Starting Strength](vsdata:core-rule/units-and-models) is 1, and it belongs to no [attached unit](vsdata:core-rule/attached-units). Roll a D3 and add 1 for each Miracle die you discarded: the model has that many wounds left, but no more than its starting wounds.

**Restrictions:** **SAINT CELESTINE** cannot be targeted, and no **CHARACTER** can be the target 2 times in the same battle.
